core_obligations: Dualizing: the pushforward of the source dualizing complex along the finite map is dualizing for the target (proof lines 3144-3146)

Normalization: the adjunction rewrites the internal hom from the residue field of the target into the pushforward as an internal hom over the source, and since the residue field of the target is a finite direct sum of copies of the residue field of the source as a module over the source, the result has cohomology only in degree zero (proof lines 3147-3156)
proof_roadmap: 由「有限映射下对偶复形前推仍对偶」引理，ω_B^• = RHom(B, ω_A^•) 对 B 对偶。
由右伴随引理：RHom_B(κ', ω_B^•) = RHom_B(κ', RHom(B, ω_A^•)) = RHom_A(κ', ω_A^•)。
κ' 作为 A-模是 κ 的有限多个拷贝的直和，且 ω_A^• 归一化 ⇒ 该复形只在 0 次有上同调 ⇒ ω_B^• 归一化。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that the pushforward of a normalized dualizing complex along a finite local map of Noetherian local rings is a normalized dualizing complex for the target (author lemma at source lines 3135-3142, label lemma-normalized-finite). The proof (source lines 3144-3157) gets the dualizing property from the finite-pushforward statement, rewrites the internal hom from the residue field through the adjunction and uses that the target residue field is a finite sum of copies of the source residue field to conclude normalization (proof lines 3144-3156). The adjunction computation is the substance. H3.
